SELECT p.x, p.n + c.n AS n
FROM (
  SELECT s.doc -> '$.x' AS x, a.n + b.n AS n
  FROM (SELECT PARSE_JSON(MAX(v)) AS doc FROM json_projection.t0) s
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM json_projection.t0) a
  CROSS JOIN [UNREORDER] (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM json_projection.t0) b
) p
CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM json_projection.t0) c

table_meta.json_projection.t0: CREATE TABLE t0 (v VARCHAR(512)) ENGINE=OLAP DUPLICATE KEY(v) DISTRIBUTED BY HASH(v) BUCKETS 1 PROPERTIES ('replication_num'='1')
table_meta.json_projection.mv0: CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW mv0 DISTRIBUTED BY RANDOM REFRESH DEFERRED MANUAL PROPERTIES ('replication_num'='1', 'query_rewrite_consistency'='LOOSE') AS SELECT v FROM json_projection.t0
